output.summary: An annual or perennial flowering herb native to Europe and southwestern Asia. It has erect hairy stems with milky sap, toothed leaves, and loose clusters of pale yellow flowers. Its young leaves are edible in salads or cooked like spinach, though their fine hairs may make them preferable mixed with other vegetables.
output.edibilityNote: Young leaves can be eaten in salads or cooked like spinach; their fine hairs may make mixing with other vegetables preferable.
